site_acres.label: Site area, acres (hypothetical lot)
site_acres.assumption: About 2.5 acres: room for a 4,200 sq ft store, eight dispensers under one canopy, parking, detention and a septic field. Yesway's older stores sit on 1.1 acres and its new large-format stores on 3.7 acres with 27 dispensers [^37]; this forecourt falls between them. The lot is hypothetical.

land_per_acre.label: Land allowance per acre
land_per_acre.assumption: An allowance, not a price found for any parcel. No land sale for the interchange area is in the research and the study takes no listing's ask, so the level is an assumption for commercial land near an I-75 interchange at the northwest edge of the Atlanta region; an appraisal and a signed contract set the value.

site_work.label: Site work: grading, paving, stormwater, septic field, lighting
site_work.assumption: A vacant lot where the case does not assume public sewer, so the budget carries an on-site septic system as well as grading, paving and detention for about 2.5 acres. No local cost index was found.

building_sf.label: Store size, square feet
building_sf.assumption: A commuter store with a hot-food counter, larger than the 3,400 square foot legacy format and smaller than the 5,800 square foot new-build format Yesway reported for 2025 [^37].

building_psf.label: Store construction cost per square foot
building_psf.assumption: Above the $1,350,000 estimated construction cost filed in October 2026 for a 6,374 square foot store in Fort Wayne, which covers vertical construction only [^43]; inside a contractor's 2026 range of $150 to $350 a square foot [^42]; construction input prices rose 7.1% in the year to June 2026 [^44].

canopy_tanks.label: Canopy, three underground tanks, piping and leak detection
canopy_tanks.assumption: Three tanks, canopy, product lines and leak detection. No dated per-tank installed cost was found; a 2026 franchise disclosure puts a whole new store and fuel site, before land, at $3,098,500 to $9,430,500 [^45], and this line is a share of a site at the bottom of that range.

dispensers.label: Fuel dispensers (16 fueling positions)
dispensers.assumption: Eight double-sided dispensers for a car-and-commuter forecourt with no truck diesel island.

dispenser_cost.label: Cost per dispenser, installed
dispenser_cost.assumption: An assumption for a high-volume retail dispenser installed with its electrical and software; no dated vendor price was found, so the bid is a lender condition.

utility_fees.label: County water and sewer connection, 2-inch meter, plan review and fire-flow test

ffe.label: Store equipment: coolers, kitchen, point of sale, shelving
ffe.assumption: Walk-in coolers, a hot-food kitchen, point of sale and fixtures for a 4,200 square foot store.

soft.label: Design, permits, survey, Phase I, legal, appraisal, study
soft.assumption: Architecture and engineering, county permits, survey, a Phase I environmental site assessment, legal, appraisal and the feasibility study.

contingency_pct.label: Hard-cost contingency
contingency_pct.assumption: 8% of site, building, canopy and tank costs, for a market where steel mill products rose 16.9% in the year to June 2026 [^44].

construction_interest.label: Interest during construction
construction_interest.assumption: About nine months of interest on a loan drawn in stages.

inventory.label: Opening fuel and merchandise inventory
inventory.assumption: Inside the $100,000 to $300,000 initial fuel inventory a 2025 franchise disclosure lists for a new fuel site [^45], plus opening merchandise.

working_capital.label: Pre-opening payroll and working capital
working_capital.assumption: Hiring and training before opening and about two months of operating losses during the ramp.

gallons.label: Fuel gallons sold
gallons.assumption: Yesway's 2025 legacy stores sold 1.0 million gallons on 10 dispensers and its new-build stores 3.1 million on 27 [^37]. This store's eight dispensers are expected to sell somewhat more per dispenser than either format, on county growth and new plants, but the site has no interstate visibility. Ramps over three years.

inside_sales.label: Inside sales, merchandise and food
inside_sales.assumption: Stabilizes at the $1.7 million Yesway's smaller legacy stores averaged in 2025 [^37]: a larger store with a food counter, but a newcomer on a secondary road. Ramps over three years.

merch_margin.label: Merchandise gross margin
merch_margin.assumption: Below Yesway's 35.2% blended inside margin for 2025 [^37], because the higher-margin food is split out.

food_margin.label: Foodservice gross margin
food_margin.assumption: Below the 58.3% Casey's earned on prepared food and dispensed beverages in the first nine months of its 2026 fiscal year [^41]; a new single store lacks its scale.

labor_hours.label: Paid staff hours per year
labor_hours.assumption: Three people on duty 17 hours a day (5 a.m. to 10 p.m.), every day, including the food counter.

wage_growth.label: Annual wage and cost growth
wage_growth.assumption: 3% a year for wages and other operating costs.

burden.label: Payroll taxes and workers' compensation
burden.assumption: Employer taxes and workers' compensation on hourly wages.

manager.label: Store manager salary
manager.assumption: A salaried manager for a new store with a food program; charged whether or not the owner fills the role.

assess_ratio.label: Assessment ratio, share of fair market value

water_kgal.label: Water use, thousand gallons a year
water_kgal.assumption: About 1,600 gallons a day for restrooms, the kitchen and cleaning.

water_rate.label: County commercial water rate per 1,000 gallons

other_opex.label: Power, insurance, repairs, card fees on inside sales, supplies
other_opex.assumption: Electricity for coolers, kitchen and canopy; property and liability insurance; repairs and tank testing; card fees on inside sales; supplies and systems.

uses.label: Land, about 2.5 acres (allowance)
uses.basis: Acres x allowance per acre (assumption); appraisal to confirm

uses.label: Design, permits, Phase I, legal, appraisal

opex.label: Property tax
opex.expr: (site_acres * land_per_acre + site_work + building_sf * building_psf + canopy_tanks) * assess_ratio * (county_mills + school_mills) / 1000

proposed.note: the sponsor proposes the 10% start-up minimum
